comment: V1 billboard/ad-surface placements. Each entry has a stable id assigned at creation — the self-serve ad backend (Phase 2) will key on these ids. Never change an id once created; add new entries or mark removed ones with 'retired': true instead. Coordinates are real-world lat/lon, projected at runtime via road.project(). side: which side of the road the post stands on (relative to direction of travel). variant: which placeholder creative to show (a=advertise-here, b=big-up-jamaica, c=drive-left, d=faiths-pen).
